correctness.rationale: In the pure refinement-order structure, the possible one-more-move relations of z to any selected pair (x,y) reduce to E/L/G/I masks. The inspected proof derives the masks from atoms, coatoms and extremality; the only quantitative dependencies are r(x) in 0,1,2,>=3, c(x) analogously, and whether a comparable gap has size 1 or >=2. For n>=7 all seven clipped ranks (0,3),(1,3),(2,3),(3,3),(3,2),(3,1),(3,0) occur, which gives a q=3 EF strategy. Rank-three sentences built from L1,L2,L3 and their duals distinguish n>=2,...,7, proving exactness and B7=877. A separately written Python finite-model checker enumerated full rank-three sentence signatures for n=1..5, obtaining five distinct signatures; the unbounded claim depends on the extension-table proof, not finite samples. The source code additionally tests 813297 ordered-pair masks through n=7 and samples n=8; its logs alone are not proof.
